assumptions: Tỷ VND. Tập đoàn hư cấu Vân Sắt. Báo cáo giả lập hai năm; bản audit final có quyền ưu tiên hơn deck sơ bộ. Một material error năm 2024 sửa hồi tố; actual 2025 đã điều chỉnh. Tax rate 20% trên các profit changes, no other tax difference; prior tax overpayment credited receivable, no cash refund. No dividend changes.

evidence.text: [BCTC 2024 original, page 12] Revenue 1.000, COGS 620, selling/admin 200, depreciation 40 (separate), interest 30, tax 22. Profit 88. Reported ending inventory 130, gross AR 150, tax receivable zero, equity 500. All liabilities not affected by error.

[Audit finding, page 55] Invoice 100 for goods physically delivered Jan5 2025 was incorrectly recognized as 2024 revenue; cost 60 removed from inventory prematurely. Customer had not paid at 31/12/2024. The audit reverses both revenue and COGS retrospectively; tax effect 20% of profit correction creates tax receivable.

[2025 final P&L, page 13] Revenue 1.180 includes corrected January delivery 100; COGS 730 includes matching cost 60, selling/admin 220, depreciation 45, interest 35, tax 30. No separate disposal or nonrecurring income.

[2025 working capital, page 18] Opening corrected gross AR and inventory from restated 2024; 2025 credit sales entire 1.180; cash receipts1.100, writeoffs0. Purchases 760, all goods received; no inventory adjustments besides COGS.

[2025 cash flow, page 21] CFO 135 after paid interest/tax, capex cash90, disposal proceeds10 (carrying10, no gain), net new borrowings40, dividends cash20. Opening cash80. Tax receivable remains unpaid, no other cash movements.

[2025 debt note, page 42] Debt opening 250, net cash borrowings40, direct vendor-financed equipment30 (noncash), no other debt movement. Closing debt 320. Cash balance includes restricted deposit25, unchanged throughout year.
[Loan agreement, page 44] Covenant leverage = net debt / EBITDA; net debt subtracts unrestricted cash only, EBITDA EBIT + depreciation. Limit2.0x. Do not subtract tax receivable or AR from debt.
[2024 management deck, page 4] Claims 2024 revenue growth and AR growth prove strong customer demand; no 2023 numbers provided. 2025 slide compares 1.180 with original1.000 and describes 18% growth.

[Audit clarification, page 58] 2025 cost includes goods from cutoff correction, so no second reversal in 2025. The original 2024 tax expense22 is based on PBT110. Financial statement comparative columns must use restated figures.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Ngân hàng giả lập Bờ Sậy. Toy annual audited balance and regulatory report. Common equity and CET1 different; expected credit loss adjustment recognized before capital report, no tax on additional hypothetical stress. HQLA and 30-day outflow definition supplied, no real-world regulatory claim.

evidence.text: [Audited balance p.16] Gross loans 8.400, allowance320, securities1.900, unrestricted cash650, other assets700. Total assets11.330. Liabilities: deposits8.000, wholesale debt1.600, other liabilities530. Common equity1.200. No preferred/NCI.
[Credit note p.36] Stage1 gross6.600 allowance66, stage2 gross1.200 allowance96, stage3 gross600 allowance158. Total 320. Opening allowance280, writeoffs40, recoveries credited8, no FX.

[P&L p.17] NII520, net fee income140, trading income30, operating expense350, credit impairment charge determined from allowance bridge, tax40. No other items. Opening common equity1.050, common share issuance60, dividends40, OCI loss15; no other equity changes stated.

[Capital note p.48] CET1 deductions: goodwill60, other intangibles20, disallowed tax asset30, prudential adjustment10. RWA credit7.200, market600, operational700. Toy minimum CET1 11%; capital note uses audited equity1.200.

qas.question: Có xác nhận bank đạt tất cả quy định vốn và thanh khoản thật không?
qas.answer: Không. Chỉ có toy CET1/liquidity definitions và thresholds; thiếu các capital tiers, buffers, jurisdiction và supervisory requirements.

assumptions: Triệu USD. SaaS hư cấu Đốm Mây. Hợp đồng từng cohort có chính sách rõ; ARR đo contracted recurring run-rate at Dec31, không one-off/expired usage; recognition và cash separate. All numbers million USD. No tax.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Dự án điện hư cấu Gió Chàm. Toy loan covenant based on cash waterfall and verified collections. All FY figures in tỷ đồng; capacity, MWh units specified. One-time grant excluded CFADS, restricted reserve not distributable.

evidence.text: [Physical report] Installed 200 MW, 8.760 hours/year. Gross generation 800 nghìn MWh, internal loss50, delivered750. PPA tariff1,4 triệu VND/MWh delivered; no other energy receipts.

[Revenue note] All delivered output billed; opening AR100, cash collected900, no bad debt. Separate curtailment claim40 pending, not approved; no recognized revenue. Confirmed certificate sales30 fully collected.

[P&L] Cash-type opex expense500 including maintenance expense20, depreciation160, interest90, tax50. No other expense. Grant60 received from government for next-year capital expansion; deferred liability, not income.
[Cash opex] Actual cash paid470, tax paid45. Opening unrestricted cash120, restricted DSRA30. Interest cash90, debt principal180 paid. No new borrowing.
[Covenant] CFADS=energy receipts+certificate cash−cash opex−cash taxes. Debt service=interest+principal. DSCR min1.3. Exclude expansion grant and all asset disposals.

[Capex] Maintenance capex60 and expansion capex100 cash paid; maintenance expense20 already in opex, do not subtract again. Grant60 remains in separate restricted project account at year end; does not fund current capex.

[Reserve] Required DSRA closing50; transfer from unrestricted20. No other restricted cash movement except grant account60. Minimum unrestricted cash after dividend40; distribution allowed only if DSCR passes, cash sufficient and grant excluded.
[Stress] Cash energy collections fall to720, all other cash flows unchanged including debt service/reserve top-up. No dividend assumed unless covenant and cash floor pass.
[Deck] Manager uses energy revenue + pending claim + grant in CFADS, counts DSRA as available cash and uses gross generation for PPA revenue.
